import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')

def run(case):
    raw = json.dumps({'cases': [case]}).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/solver.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]

print('=== A: allgather mode 2 K=1')
case = {'primitive': 'allgather', 'mode': 2, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1, 'capacity': 1,
        'start': 100, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': r, 'p': 0} for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': d, 'upto': 3} for d in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'end'}]}
out = run(case)
print(' packets', out['packets'], 'bytes', out['bytes'], 'state', out['state'])
print(' snapshots', out['snapshots'][0]['state'])
print('=== B: reducescatter mode 3 K=8')
case = {'primitive': 'reducescatter', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 8, 'words': 2,
        'capacity': 4, 'start': 5000, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'train', 'p': 0, 'count': 8, 'width': 4, 'ranks': [0, 1, 2, 3]},
                   {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'end'}]}
out = run(case)
print(' packets', out['packets'], 'bytes', out['bytes'], 'state', out['state'])
print(' snapshots', out['snapshots'][0]['state'])
print('=== C: broadcast mode 2 K=2 root=2')
case = {'primitive': 'broadcast', 'mode': 2, 'root': 2, 'segments': 2, 'words': 1, 'capacity': 2,
        'start': 9, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': 2, 'p': 0}, {'op': 'data', 'rank': 2, 'p': 1},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 2}, {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 1, 'upto': 2},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 3, 'upto': 2}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'end'}]}
out = run(case)
print(' packets', out['packets'], 'bytes', out['bytes'], 'state', out['state'])
print(' snapshots', out['snapshots'][0]['state'])
print('=== D: barrier mode 2')
case = {'primitive': 'barrier', 'mode': 2, 'root': 1, 'segments': 1, 'words': 0, 'capacity': 1,
        'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': r, 'p': 0} for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': d, 'upto': 1} for d in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'end'}]}
out = run(case)
print(' packets', out['packets'], 'bytes', out['bytes'], 'state', out['state'])
print('=== E: budget starvation then release')
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1, 'capacity': 1,
        'start': 0, 'trace': 32,
        'events': [{'op': 'budget', 'n': 2}] +
                  [{'op': 'data', 'rank': r, 'p': 0} for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'budget', 'n': -1}, {'op': 'flush'}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'end'}]}
out = run(case)
print(' packets', out['packets'], 'bytes', out['bytes'], 'state', out['state'])
